# Broadcast Input: what's typed in one pane goes to every pane of the tab,
# never to a read-only one (Stop Sending Input) — keys, nor text an input
# method commits (中 and 文 here, as an emoji from the picker or dictation
# would be). Keys between them, so only a pane that got the committed text
# alone would show it together.
action:new_split:right
wait:1.5
action:toggle_readonly
action:goto_split:previous
wait:0.3
action:toggle_broadcast_input
type:echo 中X文-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:中X文-42
expect-not:中文
